confidence_notes: Current Chania price-index entries anchor meals, cappuccino, and beer. Cocktail pricing is less certain; the estimate uses a city cost-of-living entry checked against beer, and wine is estimated at about 1.25 times draft beer. July accommodation prices are holistic high-season estimates and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use direct Chania price data. Accommodation uses Chania's high-season Crete tourism context; no comparable city or live lodging rates were used.
